description: This file contains functional tests for the Basket/Index page of a web application, using Xunit and Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc.Testing to perform HTTP requests and validate responses. The tests focus on updating item quantities in the shopping basket and handling empty basket scenarios.

classes.name: IndexTest
classes.description: A test class for verifying the functionality of the Basket Index page, including updating items and handling empty basket scenarios.

methods.name: OnPostUpdateTo50Successfully
methods.description: Test method that simulates adding an item to the basket, updating its quantity to 50, and verifying the total amount displayed.

methods.name: OnPostUpdateTo0EmptyBasket
methods.description: Test method that simulates adding an item to the basket, then setting its quantity to zero, resulting in an empty basket message.
